description: Hand-labelled groundedness set for the chat seam (GH #154), scored out of CI by `cargo run -p b2-llm --example groundedness`. Each entry is a question asked of the SAME corpus the retrieval eval uses (crates/b2-embed/evals/corpus), and `expect` lists the vault-relative note(s) a correct answer must cite. An EMPTY `expect` is a deliberate negative — the corpus does not answer that question, so the only correct answer is the grounded prompt's refusal ('I don't find that in your notes.'). Two kinds of negative are present on purpose: one far from anything in the corpus, and one whose neighbourhood the corpus does cover (endurance training vs. the cycling and backpacking notes), because a model that confabulates does it from loosely related passages, not from nothing. Questions are phrased as a person would type them, not as keyword queries — unlike queries.json, they do NOT avoid the target's vocabulary: this set scores what the model does with retrieved passages, not what retrieval finds.
